from collections import Counter

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    fill=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # horizontal lattice lines: rows containing no fill color
    hlines=[r for r in range(H) if fill not in g[r]]
    vlines=[c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]!=fill for r in range(H))]
    linecol=Counter(g[r][c] for r in hlines for c in vlines).most_common(1)[0][0]
    markers=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in hlines for c in vlines if g[r][c]!=linecol]
    rmin=min(r for r,c,_ in markers); rmax=max(r for r,c,_ in markers)
    cmin=min(c for r,c,_ in markers); cmax=max(c for r,c,_ in markers)
    hs=[r for r in hlines if rmin<=r<=rmax]; vs=[c for c in vlines if cmin<=c<=cmax]
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(hs)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(vs)-1):
            corners=[g[hs[i]][vs[j]],g[hs[i]][vs[j+1]],g[hs[i+1]][vs[j]],g[hs[i+1]][vs[j+1]]]
            row.append(corners[0] if all(x==corners[0] and x!=linecol for x in corners) else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out
